name: Adobe Firefly — Generate
description: Firefly Generate API (the flagship service): an ImageGenerationPort + adapter for text-to-image and the image-edit operations (generative fill/expand, image-to-image, style transfer) over the adobe-firefly-core foundation. Async via FireflyJobPort; presigned IO; content-credentials and safety flags pass through as port options.

questions.prompt: Which Generate operations will you use?

checklist: Confirm the Firefly Generate entitlement + scope on your Adobe Developer Console project
Verify the current endpoints/payloads against Adobe docs — Firefly paths version frequently (this scaffold posts to /v3/images/{generate,fill,expand})
The edit operations (fill/expand/image-to-image/style-transfer) need presigned input + output hrefs — use core passthrough or install an adobe-firefly-storage-* addon
Content Credentials (C2PA) and safety/moderation are pass-through options on the port (contentCredentials / safety) — set them per call, they are not hardcoded
Override the model per environment via ADOBE_FIREFLY_DEFAULT_MODEL; default output size is set at install (ADOBE_FIREFLY_SIZE)
